verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs describe short-lived session JWTs with refresh (clerk-docs-6/22/32) and explicit session-lifecycle management including active device monitoring and per-device/session revocation (clerk-supp-session-devices), which covers expiry, refresh, and revocation as claimed. However a hands-on community report describes production token-refresh failures requiring manual weekend fixes (clerk-comm-1), directly contradicting the reliability of the refresh mechanism in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of instant/reliable server-side revocation propagation and no corroborating success reports to offset the refresh-failure account.
